title: uz::Application Abstraction for Demos and Runtime
description: All demos and the main runtime use the uz::Application base class that handles window creation, RHI initialization, main loop, and shutdown. Demos override OnInit/OnUpdate/OnRender/OnShutdown. This eliminated boilerplate duplication across 10+ demos and ensures consistent lifecycle management. Migrated from raw main() functions to uz::Application in commit 67a2fac.
whenToUse: When creating new demos. When implementing the main runtime executable. When adding new lifecycle hooks (resize, focus, etc.).
whenNotToUse: For headless tools (uzcook, uzembed) that don't need windowed rendering.
